tldr: Russia released former US Marine Robert Gilman from detention on humanitarian grounds, following reports of his poor health.
Lebanon's parliament voted to abolish the death penalty, a decision that would make it the first country in the Middle East to do so, pending cabinet approval.
Global oil prices rose significantly following Iran's statement that the Strait of Hormuz would remain closed until specific conditions are met and President Trump's demand for reparations from Iran.

market.why: Both the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed lower on August 10, 2026, as Wall Street drifted lower due to a drag from the tech sector and fading optimism regarding US-Iran peace.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield increased on August 10, 2026, amid rising oil prices spurred by heightened tensions with Iran.

vix.why: The VIX, a measure of market volatility, rose on August 10, 2026, reflecting increased uncertainty as optimism for US-Iran peace faded and mixed signals emerged regarding the situation with Iran.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: Apple is reportedly developing an iOS feature called "Apple Reference Image" to embed provenance metadata into iPhone photos, allowing users to verify if an image was taken by an iPhone camera and is not a deepfake.

Researchers uncovered a major security vulnerability in Zoom, dubbed "Zoomsday" hack, which could allow an attacker to hijack a device during a meeting and was discovered using fewer than 20 prompts on publicly available AI models.
Anthropic announced it will apply invisible, machine-readable watermarks to Claude-generated text and images in an effort to comply with European AI transparency regulations.

world.summary: Russia released former U.S. Marine Robert Gilman from detention on humanitarian grounds, following reports of his poor health after being arrested in 2022.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Russia is using North Korean ballistic missiles in its strikes against Ukraine, citing an attack in Zaporizhzhia that killed seven people.
Lebanon's parliament voted to abolish the death penalty, a measure that would make it the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment if approved by the cabinet.
